report:
Reviewed the complete fixtures claim and all 13 associated tests. All entries are ordinary; there are no TODO/N/A deferrals. The initial review found missing grammar evidence, now supplied by fixture_grammar.rs and re-reviewed after a fresh start.

Implementation: compile/mod.rs macro accepts comma-separated name:value fields, string-literal file-map keys and expression values, with optional trailing commas; calls setter methods in input order. source maps evaluated text to src/lib.rs; files replaces one shared option with an assertion, enforcing exactly one source/files field; prepare rejects absence. edition and expectation setters reject duplicates; unavailable method names reject unknown fields at compilation. validate_files requires src/lib.rs, detects duplicate paths, absolute/parent paths, file-prefix directory conflicts and reserved Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/build.rs/.cargo configuration. Materialization creates parent directories and writes each evaluated source. rustc.rs (now directly associated) passes src/lib.rs as its fixed compilation input. driver.rs loads package text inputs including non-rs files and files outside src, rooted at the selected library source. parse/items.rs module_directory and resolve_mod_file implement implicit child.rs/child/mod.rs selection with ambiguity rejected, and explicit path lookup. parse/attrs.rs extracts module path attributes; local_syms/mods.rs carries inline directories and parses demanded file-backed modules; source.rs normalizes their logical paths. observe.rs recursively visits selected modules, registers their files, and rejects any marker whose file is outside that set. Merely registering source inputs does not compile unreferenced files.

Test mapping: rejects_ambiguous_or_escaping_files asserts errors for missing root, each reserved generated/configuration file category, duplicate path, parent traversal, absolute path, and file/directory conflict. unused_file_annotations_fail asserts the selected-crate rejection for an unreferenced marker. modules_and_associated_bodies observes u16 from a nested mod.rs body, proving file materialization and demand. ambiguous_module_files_are_not_silently_selected requires rejection of two implicit candidates. explicit_module_path_selects_one_of_two_candidate_files observes the explicitly selected child and leaves a type-invalid alternate file uncompiled, exercising both explicit selection and unreferenced-file exclusion. Four review_fixture tests check non-rs files, package files outside src, inline module directories, and inline path directory overrides using mandatory rustc warning-marker matching (unused markers would fail). path_attribute_inside_inline_module_uses_its_module_directory adds a Sage type observation in the selected nested file.

New grammar tests visibly assert missing selection, duplicate source/files, both mixed source/files orders, and duplicate edition/observations/diagnostics/queries by their intended panic messages. The positive grammar test observes anonymous source as src/lib.rs, uses indoc and an evaluated String expression, ordinary/raw literals, reordered options and file entries, nested model/detail directories, and both present/absent trailing commas. unknown_field_and_root_selection_fail_to_compile builds disposable callers against the real exported macro and requires the specific no-method diagnostic for an unknown field and root, excluding unrelated compiler/setup failures. Its Cargo setup follows the captured existing callsite test; the complete new file is additionally captured for imports. Macro and setters reside in the already associated mod.rs, so their future changes invalidate this review.

Executed: cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib rejects_ambiguous_or_escaping_files passed (1 test); cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test fixture_grammar passed (3 tests, including both compile-fail probes); cargo fmt completed; cargo build succeeded. Other associated tests were inspected, not re-executed in this review. Workspace-wide post-codegen and Sage sanity checks remain coordinator verification obligations and are not claimed as executed here. No remaining edits are requested for this anchor.
